text:
maria: quick follow-up from the quota/rate sync — we're seeing an odd interaction where short-lived abuse flags during canaries cause large instantaneous credit drains, which then push healthy clients into probation. any ideas on a graceful tapering approach?
kevin: ugh, yes. saw that on staging yesterday. looks like the abuse scorer writes a high penalty and the reservation layer immediately deducts a corresponding chunk.
devon: can we split the operation? scorer emits a transient penalty signal and admissions apply a fractional escrow first (eg 20%) then reap the rest over a decay window. avoids a single big drop.
maria: that matches what i was thinking. proposal: "escrow tapering" — escrow taken immediately = max(penalty*alpha, min_escrow) then background drain with half-life T. alpha default 0.25. thoughts?
lee: love the half-life idea, but need to handle headroom for bursty models (small sequences but many requests). maybe escrow should be token-aware: escrow = min(tokens_in_request * token_factor, penalty*alpha).
riley: +1 for token-aware. also, we should clamp by per-tenant burst allowance so infra isn't surprised. otherwise Dedicated customers see unexpected latency when their reservoir goes negative.
kevin: infra concern: background drain requires bookkeeping. how about we approximate decay by adding a scheduled reconciler that emits a "release" credit every 5s per tenant rather than per-request timers. cheaper and deterministic.
devon: yeah, reconciler approach good. add a short-lived in-memory lease that stores (escrow_amount, release_rate, expires_at). reconciler sweeps leases and credits back. if tenant gets another penalty, we top-up escrow atomically.
maria: sounds implementable. we should also add a safety: if abuse score persists > probation_window (e.g., 2m) then switch to hard admission (no more taps) and surface alert to security.
ops-bot: deploybot: staged rollout plan created at https://go/internal/rfcs/escrow-tapering - canary -> 10% -> 50% -> 100% (1h between phases). tag: @eng-platform @eng-infra
lee: small nit: telemetry — emit events: escrow_taken, escrow_released, escrow_forfeited, escrow_clamped. include model, tokens, tenant_id, and reason. this will help tune alpha/T.
riley: and add an explainer doc for customers: "Why you might see short probation during canaries" — helps avoid support noise.
maria: next steps: kevin + devon to prototype reconciler and lease shape; lee to add telemetry schema; riley to draft customer note; i'll drive the rollout plan with ops-bot. i'll create a short RFC summary later today. thanks all :thumbsup:
kevin: ok i'll spin up a spike branch tomorrow and post logs.
devon: will mock the lease store API: `PutLease(tenant, amount, rate, expires)` and `TopUpLease(tenant, delta)` and a reconciler that emits `Release(tenant, amount)`. will share PR link when ready.
maria: perfect. if any blockers post here or ping me.
